llmJudgeRequirements.description: App component renders `QueryClientProvider` with `client` set to `queryClient` and wraps `ItemsScreen`
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: App component renders only <ItemsScreen /> with no QueryClientProvider or queryClient instance visible anywhere in the submitted files.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Items `queryFn` reads `signal` from `QueryFunctionContext` and passes it to `fetchItems`
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: queryFn is defined as a plain async arrow function with no parameters; it does not destructure or use QueryFunctionContext signal, and does not pass a signal to any fetch call.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Create flow uses `useMutation` object form with `mutationFn` set to `createItem`
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: useMutation is called with an object literal containing mutationFn as an inline async function that performs the create POST request.
evidence: const mutation = useMutation({ mutationFn: async (title: string) => { ... } })

llmJudgeRequirements.reason: onSuccess callback calls queryClient.invalidateQueries with the todos query key.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Create button `disabled` prop uses `isPending` from mutation
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Pressable has disabled={mutation.isPending} directly bound to the mutation's isPending state.
